summary: Comprehensive architectural and implementation plan for IDVERA, a Transfer-Aware, Privacy-Preserving Enrolment Reconciliation (TPER) web platform for AICTE-approved institutions. Outlines the 12 navigation areas, versioned rule engine (V-01 to V-12), privacy-preserving temporal duplicate matching stages A-E, dual-engine reconciliation, verification adapter, test bench, benchmark suite, and role-based permissions.
